note: Each invalid fixture must produce at least these error codes. Valid fixtures must produce no errors.

decision-without-else.json.description: A decision with no else route

decision-without-unknown.json.description: A decision with no unknown route

loop-undeclared.json.description: A cycle that is not a declared loop

loop-exhausted-inside.json.description: Exhausted route stays inside the loop

loop-no-exit.json.description: A loop whose body has no way out

loop-return-forward.json.description: A loop return edge that goes forward

unreachable-node.json.description: A node not reachable from the input

dead-end.json.description: A step that never reaches a terminal

join-required-on-optional-branch.json.description: A join requires an input that only arrives on one decision branch

private-to-actor.json.description: An agent step reads the private rubric key

human-without-timeout.json.description: A human step with no timeout route

artifact-not-available.json.description: A step reads an artifact produced later

unknown-role.json.description: An agent step names a role that does not exist

unbounded-loop-limit.json.description: A loop with no positive iteration limit

executable-text-is-rejected.json.description: Extra fields such as code are rejected by the strict schema
